sample_complaints: Bought this item with high expectations of its capabilities. It would be extremely lenghty to supply full details, let me just say that technology is not there yet with AI devices like this....
I don't recommended if you are using Apple products

Not very functional and never had all the answers I needed. And I wanted a device I could make phone calls to anyone with in which the Google home does. We purchased the Google home and we are so glad we did.

We got this for our son. He is always wanting to play on Mom's tablet so we thought this would be a good choice. His aunt does a lot of tech shopping and bought this same one for his sister so we got the same one. Within a month the charging cord on both units quit working and shortly after that the ports became squirly so you have to hold them just right or they don't charge. Save your money and get a more expensive but better quality product.

Not as easy as it sounded like it was going to be. So many things to buy to get full use out of what we knew we COULD do. Every question we seem to ask Alexa/she says she doesn't know the answer and that we'd have to "download the app" - so we never use her/only to ask her to set a timer and tell us the time and ask her to play music, which we also had to set up first. Not as neat as we thought she was going to be.

Hopefully, this will at least work as an e-reader. Otherwise, Amazon has it locked up so tight one cannot do much else with it. And, even with my fiber optic Wi-Fi it is slower than cold molasses in January in Canada. Well, I needed a Kindle e-reader and for $40 that is ok.

I had a Nook, but it died so I wanted a replacement, and bought this Fire tablet on black friday last year because it was very inexpensive, but as the old adage goes, you get what you pay for. It's OK for basic web surfing, but it's limited, slow, and has one little speaker on the back so if you lay it on a table you won't be able to hear it very well.
Product was damaged. Needs lot of improvement on the API's.

worst_product.name: Certified Refurbished Amazon Fire TV with Alexa Voice Remote
sample_complaints: Certified garbage! Lesson learned about paying attention to reviews. Fire TV box and remote was packaged like new, even included new batteries. After plugging it in it would only show Amazon logo and 'unknown boot' on screen. Cycled power several times and even tried to reset using remote buttons, no dice. I read all the negative reviews before I purchased this, I chose to take the chance so I'm angry with myself, but very disappointed with Amazon for even suggesting this is refurbished, let alone certified, as if that means something.

Stay away from the certified refurbished Amazon Fire TV. I received two Certified Refurbished defective fire TVs. The first the screen looked half corrupted, see the pictures. The second Certified Refurbished Amazon fire tv I received would not boot up, it was stuck in an infinite loop where I would only see the amazon logo for 10 seconds then it would boot up again.If anything, Amazon needs to re-visit its refurbishment process and quality control of the refurbished products they let get in consumer hands.Update 11/28/16: I purchased a new Fire TV during the BF sale and I have had no issues so far :).

I bought this thing refurbished. I find that I have to unplug / plug back in the HDMI cable on a regular basis when switching inputs on the TV. Not sure if it is the Amazon Fire box itself or if it is the TV (Not likely).Otherwise it is a good device. I bought it for the ability to hard wire my Ethernet connection to my gigabit switch and for 4K capabilities which it does do. Having the Alexa app is handy but her features can be severely handicapped.I probably should have just bought it new..... usually refurbished devices work well as they are tested before resale and it was probably tough to catch that the HDMI port on these might be finicky. I may have to switch it out.

### Entertainment Tablets & Media Devices: Top Recommendations

When it comes to entertainment tablets and media devices, there are a few standout options that consistently receive high praise from users. 

#### Top Picks
1. **Fire TV Stick Streaming Media Player Pair Kit**  
   - **Average Rating:** 5.0 / 5.0 (6 reviews)  
   - **Key Points:** This product boasts a perfect score and has received no negative feedback, indicating exceptional customer satisfaction. Reviewers appreciate its ease of use and performance.

2. **Amazon Echo and Fire TV Power Adapter**  
   - **Average Rating:** 4.88 / 5.0 (8 reviews)  
   - **Key Points:** With a slightly lower rating but still impressive, this product also has no negative reviews. Customers highlight its reliability and functionality, making it a great companion for entertainment devices.

3. **Echo (White)**  
   - **Average Rating:** 4.65 / 5.0 (3,310 reviews)  
   - **Key Points:** Although it has a high average rating, it does come with some criticism. Reviewers note that while it has many capabilities, it sometimes falls short in delivering on expectations, particularly in terms of AI functionality and compatibility with Apple products.

#### What Reviewers Complain About
- **Fire TV Stick Streaming Media Player Pair Kit:** Reviewers had few complaints, indicating a strong overall satisfaction with this device.
- **Amazon Echo and Fire TV Power Adapter:** Reviewers had few complaints, further supporting its reputation for being a dependable product.
- **Echo (White):** Common complaints include:
  - Expectations not met regarding AI capabilities.
  - Incompatibility issues with Apple products.
  - Concerns over functionality and user experience, particularly when it comes to answering queries or performing tasks.

#### One to Avoid
- **Certified Refurbished Amazon Fire TV with Alexa Voice Remote**  
   - **Average Rating:** 3.78 / 5.0 (9 reviews)  
   - **Reasons to Avoid:** This product has garnered a significant number of negative reviews—33% of users reported dissatisfaction. Complaints include issues with booting up, defective units, and poor refurbishment quality. Many users expressed disappointment in Amazon's refurbishment process, suggesting that potential buyers steer clear of this item to avoid similar frustrations.

In summary, while there are excellent options available for entertainment devices, it's essential to weigh customer feedback when making a choice, especially regarding refurbished products.
